candidate: `PandasIndexAdapter` in xarray/core/indexing.py preserves a custom `_dtype`; when re-wrapping its `.array`, always pass `dtype=self._dtype` or the dtype is lost. Prefer giving the adapter its own `copy(deep=...)` method so callers don't reconstruct it manually and drop metadata.

Shallow-copying a pandas Index (`.copy(deep=False)`) can cause its underlying numpy arrays to become deep copies upon pickling, bloating size; use `deep=True` when a true shared reference isn't needed.
xarray type hints use `DTypeLike` from `xarray/core/npcompat`, not numpy directly.
